misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast specification linked to its issuance time, evidence cutoff, and later settlement could establish whether the target-time price diverged from a forecast available beforehand. The supplied records do not establish that it did.
misses.decision_reference: Existing evidence-gap registry: EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE state that forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs are missing.
misses.decision_relevance: The supplied settlement prices cannot be compared with a decision available beforehand, so they do not demonstrate a forecast or decision failure.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: target-time BTC and ETH mark-price settlements are supplied, but no linked prior forecast specification or issuance-time information set is available. No demonstrated decision miss or portfolio result can be identified.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked outcomes are absent. Settlement target timestamps are explicitly adjudication times, not source-observation or decision timestamps.
misses.outcome_reference: Supplied FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 and the other listed EXP-FC records, contain confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices. The registry states that these prices are not linked to an available prior forecast specification.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
